correctness.rationale: The exhaustive independent face enumerations agree on all 131072 subsets; 423 disjoint elementary toggles form an acyclic matching checked over all 2856 Hasse incidences. The 21 critical cells have dimension counts 1 (dimension 0), 1 (dimension 2), and 19 (dimension 3). Signed integer gradient cancellation produces a primitive one-row boundary with three coefficients -1; a degree-one three-cell contracts the only 2-sphere and leaves 18 three-spheres. Direct mod-two ranks independently agree. The C17 representation follows by a fixed-point-free Lefschetz calculation, not by finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: Paley(17) is a canonical vertex-transitive quadratic-residue graph. Its nonpure 2-independence complex has an exact 18-sphere integral homotopy classification, including an explicitly cancelled critical two-cell and a natural nontrivial rational translation module Q plus the regular C17-module. These are structural facts beyond Betti counts; they provide a concrete comparison to distinct topological constructions on the same graph without claiming a general Paley classification.
